about: AirNow.gov (EPA) U.S. air quality: current and forecast AQI by location, reporting-area and monitor-site history, state tables, national top AQI list, state alerts and site search. The CLI calls airnowgovapi.com and related JSON endpoints directly.

commands.summary: Autocomplete AirNow reporting area names (e.g. 'Denver-Boulder, CO') from a city name or ZIP fragment

params.name: term
params.description: Partial city name or ZIP code

commands.summary: Resolve a U.S. city, region or ZIP code to latitude/longitude (x=longitude, y=latitude) for use with get-current-aqi and get-weather

params.name: location
params.description: City name, 'City, ST' or ZIP code

commands.summary: Get current observed AQI and today/tomorrow forecasts per pollutant for the reporting area nearest a latitude/longitude

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (negative for the western hemisphere)

params.name: stateCode
params.description: Two-letter U.S. state code of the location, e.g. CO

commands.summary: Get the latitude/longitude of a named reporting area

params.name: reportingArea
params.description: Reporting area name, e.g. Austin or Denver-Boulder

commands.summary: Get the data and forecast provider agencies (with URLs) for a reporting area
Get the current interpolated PM2.5 AQI and category for a reporting area
Get current weather (temperature °F, wind, humidity, pressure) at a latitude/longitude
Get the last 24 hours of hourly AQI (with dominant pollutant) for a reporting area

params.name: reportingArea
params.description: Reporting area name exactly as AirNow spells it

commands.summary: Get the last 30 days of daily AQI (with dominant pollutant) for a reporting area

params.name: reportingArea
params.description: Reporting area name exactly as AirNow spells it

commands.summary: Get the last 24 hours of hourly AQI and concentrations per pollutant for a monitoring site

params.name: siteId
params.description: Monitor site ID (the siteID field from get-current-aqi, e.g. 9-digit AQS code 060750005 or 12-digit 840080010010)

commands.summary: Get the last 30 days of daily AQI and concentrations per pollutant for a monitoring site
List current observations and forecasts for every reporting area in a state
Get daily AQI for ozone, PM2.5 and PM10 for every reporting area in a state on a past date

params.name: state
params.description: Full state name with the first letter capitalized, e.g. Texas

commands.summary: List the U.S. reporting areas with the highest current NowCast AQI
List states that currently have an AirNow notification (e.g. Wildfires) and its alert type
Keyword search of AirNow.gov pages and documents (EPA search, scoped to www.airnow.gov), 10 results per page

params.name: filter
params.description: Extra facet filter in Solr syntax, e.g. filetype_s:"PDF" or displaylanguage_s:"English"
